config.name: flowconx_open_set
config.description:
Open-set rejection and few-shot enrollment on 5G Traffic.
Three applications are held out of training entirely -- including out of validation, or model selection leaks them back in -- and treated as unknown at test time. They are chosen to satisfy three conditions that an earlier version of this config silently violated:

  1. Each must actually appear in the session-disjoint test split. The
     previous choice (netflix, kt_gamebox, google_meet) had two apps that do
     not appear there at all, so the evaluation would have scored AUROC on a
     single held-out app contributing 2.9% of test rows.
  2. They must span different service classes, or rejection collapses into
     "reject one class".
  3. Removing each from training must leave its service class with at least
     one other application, or the class disappears from training and the
     closed-set half of the open-set metric becomes meaningless.

Chosen: ms_teams (video_conferencing, 5,868 test rows; zoom and google_meet remain in training), teamfight_tactics (online_game, 898; battleground remains), geforce_now (game_streaming, 743; kt_gamebox remains). Together 7,509 of 32,859 test rows, 22.8%, across three service classes.
Note that `roblox` is *already* unknown in this split without being declared: it has a single capture file, so session-disjoint grouping puts all of it in test. Its 6,000 test rows are scored as knowns of the metaverse class, which is why that class's per-class F1 collapses in the headline run. It is left undeclared here so that the open-set result is about the apps we chose, and the effect is documented in paper/THREATS.md instead.

probes.protocol: Embeddings from all three task splits are pooled and split 50/50 for the probe. The task's own partition is not reused, because a strict protocol makes the nuisance disjoint across it by construction.

tradeoff.reading: Nuisance leakage is the first number and task performance the second. A method that drives the first to zero while collapsing the second has not achieved invariance, it has destroyed the representation.
